visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair and brown eyes, wearing a light blue and white knitted sweater, speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and mouth movements. She gestures with both hands near her chin, framing her face. The setting is a dimly lit indoor room with warm wooden wall panels. White subtitles and a small blue brand logo appear at the bottom. (2) Transitioning outdoors, the woman carries a toddler with short black hair in a carrier on her back. She is dressed in a light blue floral top and distressed blue jeans, swinging a large black butterfly net toward a dense green hedge. The background features tall leafy trees and a clear sky, with a yellow thermometer graphic and subtitles overlaid on the scene. (3) Sitting on a wooden park bench, the woman fans herself with her right hand while holding a clear bottle of pink liquid in her left. The child sits next to her, drinking from a blue bottle. The surrounding environment is a lush green park with dappled sunlight. Blue variety text and subtitles are visible, along with a bottle and a small container on the bench. (4) A close-up view shows the woman's hands reaching into a white tote bag filled with multiple blue and white packs of Sofy sanitary pads. Each pack features colorful illustrations of daisies, lemons, or penguins. The background is slightly blurred greenery, and informative white subtitles explain the product's availability in Japan and Taiwan. (5) The woman sits back on the park bench, stretching her arms overhead with a smiling face. Two packs of sanitary pads are placed on the bench beside her. The background shows a metal fence and more green foliage. Graphical variety text and icons representing coolness levels appear, while subtitles continue to describe the product's dermatological testing. (6) A detailed product montage displays three different varieties of Sofy pads on a wooden slat surface. The packs are highlighted individually with yellow, light green, and dark blue accents. The woman is later seen holding an unwrapped white pad, pointing at its surface with her finger. Subtitles and colorful slogans indicate the specific scents and benefits like natural cooling. (7) In an indoor setting, the woman wears glasses and holds a black package of sanitary pants. The background is a soft-lit room with a teddy bear visible. Finally, she and her son sit on the park bench together, waving to the camera with several products spread out in front of them. The shot is a medium full shot with bright natural light and large closing subtitles.
